column1: Commands the agent runs as administrator (root). Administrator mode: you enter the administrator password once and for about 5 minutes LuxAI runs administrator commands without asking for it again; only this LuxAI window gets it, other programs still need the password. Requests sent to LuxAI by other programs always need your approval. Only with the Flash model; Lite always asks for the password. Destructive commands (deleting the system or home folder, formatting disks, removing the bootloader, changing accounts, sudo or polkit) are always refused. Every command is logged in ~/.local/state/luxai/root-commands.log.
column2: Perintah yang dijalankan agen sebagai administrator (root). Mode administrator: Anda memasukkan kata sandi administrator sekali dan selama sekitar 5 menit LuxAI menjalankan perintah administrator tanpa memintanya lagi; hanya jendela LuxAI ini yang mendapatkannya, program lain tetap butuh kata sandi. Permintaan yang dikirim ke LuxAI oleh program lain selalu memerlukan persetujuan Anda. Hanya dengan model Flash; Lite selalu meminta kata sandi. Perintah merusak (menghapus sistem atau folder home, memformat disk, menghapus bootloader, mengubah akun, sudo atau polkit) selalu ditolak. Setiap perintah dicatat di ~/.local/state/luxai/root-commands.log.
